title: nf-core/funcprofiler pipeline - params.database schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.database

tool.errorMessage: Invalid tool name. Please see documentation for all supported profilers.

db_name.help_text: Name of the database as a whole, i.e. the release or version you want recorded in the results (e.g. `uniref90_v3`). All rows belonging to the same database must share this name.
db_name.errorMessage: A unique name of the database should be provided.

db_entity.help_text: Name of the individual component (entity) of the database given in `db_name`. Tools that take a single database file or directory leave this empty; tools that need several components require one row per component, all sharing the same `db_name`. HUMAnN needs `humann_metaphlan`, `humann_nucleotide`, `humann_protein` and `humann_utility`; eggNOG-mapper needs `eggnogmapper_db` and `eggnogmapper_data_dir`.
db_entity.errorMessage: Invalid db_entity. For HUMAnN, specify whether db_path is the humann_metaphlan, humann_nucleotide, humann_protein or humann_utility component; for eggnogmapper, specify eggnogmapper_db or eggnogmapper_data_dir. Leave empty for tools that take a single database.

db_params.errorMessage: Invalid database db_params entry. No quotes allowed.

db_path.errorMessage: db_path should be either a file path or a directory.
